svg.title: The Missing Coordinate Family
svg.desc: A narrow cyan range is deleted from the projected coordinate mesh, removing unequal portions of its row and column families. Every fifth surviving polyline is closed into a 26-vertex polygon, then replaced by a normal-vector comb. Two neutral tones and a slight shear expose a height field whose absent coordinates remain part of the composition.
